references.text: Here reference is made to the creation account and the original purpose of marriage as a basis for Jesus' teaching on marriage and divorce.
This is the Mosaic permission for divorce that Jesus refers to and redefines in light of God's original purpose for marriage.
Jesus teaches about marriage and divorce in the Sermon on the Mount, which provides background for his answer in Matthew 19.
Mark gives a parallel account of Jesus' teaching on divorce, emphasizing the permanent nature of the marital bond.
Luke also includes Jesus' teaching on divorce, supporting what he says in Matthew 19.
Paul refers to the Lord's command regarding marriage and divorce, which is consistent with Jesus' teaching in Matthew 19.
